cause_quote: PR #179699 positioned `.chat-image-actions--overlay` at `right: 8px; bottom: 2px;` inside the preview and set `opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto;` under `@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse)`.
user_saw: On mobile, download and copy icons stayed visible over chat images.
summary: The fix hides inline image controls on non-hover or coarse-pointer devices and preserves tap-to-open access to the lightbox.
reasoning: I checked the parent stylesheet and the prior fix’s mobile test, which asserted that the image-actions menu sat outside the preview. PR #179699 restored the overlay, removed the side gutter, and made the icons persist on touch devices, reintroducing the obstruction.
